headline.text: L3 ML1 cooler failed repeatedly through the afternoon — maintenance applied water-spray workaround to keep running by *18:46*.

per_plant_summary.L1: S2 ran caramel all day with routine quality checks. Cavanna 4 alarm at 07:51 cleared by 08:02. S3 completed weekend clean and is ready for Monday morning. Short-handed on second shift required pausing MMs during lunch rotation.
per_plant_summary.L2: Foreign material found on top of WIP pallet at 08:19 — candies laying loose on Salted Caramel inventory. Alan following up on source.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 fought recurring cooler failures from 15:09 through evening. Nozzle plate clog cleared by 08:22. Morcos tank heater lost power mid-morning, Nelson found blown fuses and loose wire. Marcos tank heater contacts tripping repeatedly in evening — Nelson suspects short in display. Line completed 60g order and started level 2 clean overnight.

resolved.title: Cavanna 4 alarm on screen
resolved.summary: Cavanna 4 wrapper threw alarm; maintenance found loose back connections.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:02 — "Maintenance tightened some back connections on Cavanna 4 and it's already working" (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: E-stop preventing S3 belt run test
resolved.summary: Unknown e-stop preventing belt run test after weekend clean; searched C-19 and belt after MD before locating.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 23:42 — e-stop found by Brandon Hernandez, "5-min run test and sanitization of the belts completed" (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: Nozzle plate clogged at shift start
resolved.summary: Depositor nozzle plate remained clogged after initial reassembly; crew removed, washed, reinstalled, and purged to clear before restarting production.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:22 — nozzle plate cleaned and installed, purged, unclogged, "Running" (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: Morcos tank not heating
resolved.summary: Morcos tank temperature dropped to 38-40°F; Nelson Cook found VFD faulted and reset.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:18 — "heating up now" after VFD reset (Nelson Cook).

resolved.title: Cooler lost temp, bars not demolding
resolved.summary: Cooler temp rose to 62°F (set point 52°F) causing bars to stick in molds; maintenance found 2 blown fuses and a loose wire on heater panel.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:18 — "It's good now." Nelson Cook replaced 2 fuses and secured loose wire on heater contacts.

resolved.title: Bad temper after lunch coverage
resolved.summary: Line stopped depositing at 12:28 because covering operator took incorrect temper reading during regular operator's lunch break.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:35 — new temper taken and "Starting back up" (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: Mold alarm
resolved.summary: Mold conveyor alarm triggered, maintenance called.

resolved.title: Printer and sticker timing off
resolved.summary: Printer wasn't printing on side panel; sticker for display box applying too late on night shift startup.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:29 — Nathan Gevenois adjusted printer position for correct timing and sticker speed.

resolved.title: C6 belt drifted north
resolved.summary: C6 belt tracking drifted north, line paused for maintenance adjustment.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:09 — "Line started 5 mins ago c6 belt is good now" (Nathan Gevenois).

needs_attention.title: Foreign material on WIP pallet
needs_attention.summary: Loose candies found laying on top of Salted Caramel WIP pallet when Hector brought pallets to FFS line; unclear if from truck, warehouse steel, or L3 transfer.
needs_attention.status: Alan Todd notified at 08:11, said will follow up. Source not yet identified as of window close.

needs_attention.title: Cooler repeatedly overheating through afternoon
needs_attention.summary: ML1 cooler failed 4 times between 15:09 and 16:59 despite VFD resets and compressor spraying; maintenance rigged continuous water spray on roof compressor as workaround.
needs_attention.status: Water-spray workaround implemented by 18:46; Efrain confirmed no more issues after continuous mist applied to compressor coil. Line ran remainder of shift on reduced speed with manual cooling.

needs_attention.title: Marcos tank heater contacts tripping
needs_attention.summary: Heater contacts for Marcos tank temperature control repeatedly tripping; Nelson Cook suspects short in display panel causing intermittent power loss.
needs_attention.status: Tripping continued through evening shift. Nelson suspects display short — "when you wiggle it on the inside it will pull the contacts back in." All wires tight. Shift instructed not to adjust temper unless tank at set point.
